A food item which restores {{Energy||13}} and applies the 'Tough Mood' buff when consumed. It must be made in the [[cooking_table|cooking table]] and higher quality versions of the dish have a larger restorative effect. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

===Effect===
On use, this {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} will apply the 'Tough Mood' buff for a duration of 2 minutes, increasing the player's defense by 4 points. Quality level does not have an impact. For a list of all available buffs and their benefits, see [[effects]].
